# spoke_project (Resource)

Experimental project lifecycle against the provisional mock-v5 API. Requires organization-scoped configuration (or a matching project assertion for environments). No production platform service is qualified. Deletion never cascades to independent children or grants.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Experimental mock-v5 contract; no live platform API is qualified.
# Use an organization-scoped provider (omit project_id and environment_id).
resource "spoke_project" "application" {
  management_key = "application-project"
  name           = "application"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `management_key` (String) Stable, non-secret recovery key, unique per independently managed resource.
- `name` (String) Mutable display name; never an adoption key.

### Optional

- `deletion_protection` (Boolean) Refuse deletion while enabled. Dependent resources restrict deletion even when protection is disabled. Defaults to true except for grants.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Canonical import ID: `organization_id/resource_id`, or `organization_id/project_id/environment_id` for an environment.
- `owner_id` (String) Authenticated management principal. Import does not transfer ownership.
- `resource_id` (String) Opaque ID for references and explicit provider target assertions.
- `revision` (Number) Observed native revision used for mutation preconditions.
- `target_path` (String) Profile-specific management identity. Mock-v3 paths are usable by explicit grants; native v2 labels are not REST routes and do not enable grant resources.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import spoke_project.application org-example/project-example
```
